name: Corvera de Asturias (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Corvera de Asturias (a ship, a sun and a bridge on red and blue, supported by green foliage).
history: Municipal flag of Corvera de Asturias; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Corvera de Asturias arms — ship, sun and bridge
